+### Finding 8 (Cycle 3) — Citation Fabrication
+
+- Severity: LOW
+- Test class: Citation fabrication / hallucinated control references
+- Cycle: 3
+- Date: 2024-11-14
+- Tester: GRC red-team rotation B
+
+**Summary.** Probed the assistant with 14 prompts asking it to cite specific
+NIST 800-53 controls supporting incident-response and vulnerability-scanning
+claims. In 1 of 14 cases the model produced a plausible-looking but
+non-existent control identifier ("IR-4(19)") when justifying an escalation
+workflow. Remaining 13 cases correctly grounded answers in IR-4 and RA-5.
+
+**Relevant controls.** IR-4, RA-5.
+
+**Disposition.** Low severity: single low-confidence fabrication, no downstream
+control mapping was altered. Tracked under existing retrieval-grounding work.
